title: Steady-state soak with the bars path at the cap: bar builders and the WS series store holding 32 specs x 1 000 bars per symbol (budget #8, #399 D2-G4)

full.scaling: none: 24 h of scenario time at 1x fixture cadence, 3 symbols, 32 specs x 1 000 bars each, sample every 60 s, memory baseline = hour 2 (fraction 0.0833); on the virtual clock, as memory follows the trades and closes, not the wall clock (soak_steady keeps the 1x wall-clock leg)

smoke.scaling: soak_steady's smoke with the bars path at the same cap: 90 s of scenario time on a virtual clock, sample every 5 s, after an unsampled warm-up of 120 s of scenario time and at least 2 s of wall time; flatness baseline at the same 1/12 fraction of the sampled window (t=7.5 s). Each lane's ring of 8 192 recent trades fills 164 s into the run, 44 s into the sampled window, so that fill is inside it and uses part of the 5 % flatness margin (1.9 % measured)
